answer: New identities sit under a damping curve: influence accrues only across consecutive epochs of graded work and stays capped low until tenure builds, so voting power cannot be bought in bulk. A fresh ballot weighs a fraction of a veteran's, and splitting a farm into a thousand wallets gains nothing, since each clone climbs the same ramp alone and inherits no history. Influence is a cipher keyed on tenure times passing grades, not on balance. Attacker cost: N parallel ramps over many epochs with no pooling, a long sable wait, and a sparrow's weight on night one.
